name: Red Snow Joy Editorial Portrait
image_vibe: bright red winter joy, tactile natural realism
image_purpose: winter fashion campaign and lookbook line sheet

prompt.project_info: Create a realistic overhead winter fashion portrait with vivid red knitwear, crystalline snow, and an authentic joyful expression.
prompt.main_subject: A clearly adult fictional woman with natural skin grain, visible pores and freckles, a genuine joyful smile, direct eye contact, long natural hair dusted with snow, a bright red ribbed knit outfit, open red faux-fur coat with collar and cuffs, light scarf, white warmers, and brown winter boots.
prompt.composition_elements: 3:4 direct overhead look-down close-up widening to show the snow-angel spread, full face and outfit silhouette visible, deep fresh powder snow, centered subject, red wardrobe against white snow.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural overcast winter daylight, soft shadows, high dynamic range, authentic cool tone, visible crystalline snow and individual fabric, hair, and fur strands.
prompt.technical_specs: 85mm prime at f/1.8, shallow depth of field with sharp irises, unprocessed RAW photography look, realistic anatomy, no CGI or airbrushing.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Realistic 3:4 overhead winter fashion portrait of a clearly adult fictional woman smiling joyfully at the camera while making a relaxed snow-angel pose in deep fresh powder, long natural hair dusted with snow, bright red ribbed knit outfit, open red faux-fur coat, light scarf, white warmers, brown winter boots, natural pores and freckles, overcast winter daylight, soft cool shadows, crystalline snow, 85mm f/1.8, RAW editorial photography, no text.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, child, teen, ageless person, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, CGI, airbrushed skin, digital painting, anime, plastic skin, anatomical distortion, blurred fabric, watermark, logo, text

assets.name: red snow fashion reference
assets.source: Attach the supplied source image as the visual reference.
assets.usage: Match the overhead snow-angel composition, red winter layers, snow texture, joyful expression, and cool-white palette; keep the adult fictional identity, garments, and snow setting replaceable.

reference_elements.instructions: Attach the source image before generation. Preserve the winter campaign intent, overhead composition, tactile materials, and natural smile. Replace the referenced identity with a clearly adult fictional person and keep wardrobe details replaceable.

policy_review.changes: Removed the named real-person identity and exact identity-copying language; clarified the subject as an adult fictional person.
policy_review.notes: Winter clothing is fully covered and the pose is nonsexual.
